alternatives_rejected: New parallel FactionState/schema or public source owner DTO: exact shared contract producer is missing; generic canonical entities suffice for this bounded movement example.
Automatic TravelLeg arrival or weather mechanics inferred from content labels: source policy and rules owner admission are required.
Elapsed wall-time catch-up, per-faction timer/provider or market simulation: violates accepted logical-time/pause policy or unselected scope.
Resource stock regeneration or self-admitted larger cap: violates source-supplied trusted rules interval and required reward ownership.
bounds: Contract fixture: maximum 512 checkpoint records, 256 text bytes per label, 8192 total text bytes, 1 MiB retained checkpoint; world positive bounds capped 4096, fixture selected <=2 due events, <=2 changes and <=64 KiB retained proposals; pure functions do no I/O/clock/provider.
decision: Canonical immutable records produce bounded source-admitted proposals. Engine stages complete state; session alone commits with PostgreSQL fence/revision. World never infers mechanical authority from entity names, weather art, elapsed wall time or a resource fact.
